paper_title: Revised constraints and Belle II sensitivity for visible and invisible axion-like particles
notes: Review/reinterpretation paper (Dolan, Ferber, Hearty, Kahlhoefer, Schmidt-Hoberg). Headline measured result is the revised existing constraints on the ALP-photon coupling g_agamma (Fig 2, left panel, photon-coupling case g_aZ=0); the Belle II sensitivity curves are projections (out of scope). Curve is the lower boundary (upper limit on g_agamma) of the paper OWN combined excluded region, built from the e-print ancillary exclusion grids (anc/*.dat, contour bound=0): DELPHI mono-photon (LEP), BaBar, radiative Upsilon (Y), electron beam dumps E137+E141, proton beam dumps CHARM+nuCal, and SN1987A energy-loss (Energylossexclusion.dat). Flat floor g~6.3e-9 GeV^-1 at low mass is the SN1987A energy-loss bound, matching the paper quoted value g_agamma<6e-9 for small m_a. Rise near 0.1-0.5 GeV is the E137 beam-dump turnoff; steep rise beyond ~0.5 GeV is the closing of the beam-dump/BaBar region toward the high-coupling collider band. NOT included: the deeper SN1987A a->gamma-gamma (visible burst) region reaching ~1e-10, which the paper borrows from ref [50] (its lower edge is off-plot/cropped at 1e-10) and is not the paper own derivation; the high-coupling LEP e+e->gg band (g>~5e-3, from ref [21]) and Pb-Pb heavy-ion strip. Masses converted GeV->eV (x1e9). CL 95% for all except BaBar (90%); difference imperceptible per paper.
